title: U.S. House · Texas's 6th District
area: Navarro County and part of Ellis County, southeast of Dallas–Fort Worth

context.text: Incumbent Jake Ellzey (R) defeated James Buford and Brian Stahl in the March 3, 2026 Republican primary. Danny Minton won the Democratic primary unopposed.

candidates.name: Jake Ellzey

summary.text: Jake Ellzey is the Republican incumbent U.S. Representative for Texas's 6th Congressional District, a retired Navy pilot and former state legislator.

background.text: Born in Potter County, Texas, in 1970; earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the United States Naval Academy in 1992.
Served in the U.S. Navy from 1992 to 2012; later worked as a civilian contractor, commercial airline pilot, and commissioner for the Texas Veterans Commission.
Served in the Texas House of Representatives in 2021 before being elected to Congress.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Appropriations (including the Defense, Interior-Environment, and Labor, Health and Human Services, Education subcommittees) and the House Committee on Small Business in the 2025–2026 Congress.

candidates.researchNotes: No Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey or curated key-messages profile was found for Ellzey in this race's coverage; positions on specific issues were not documented from the sources checked.

candidates.name: Danny Minton
candidates.ballotNote: Won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed

summary.text: Danny Minton is a former Republican and medical-field sales consultant running as the Democratic nominee for Texas's 6th Congressional District.

background.text: Graduated from the University of Oklahoma with a degree in zoology and completed master's-level work in epidemiology.
Worked in the medical field as a consultative salesman, training physicians and supporting patients with illnesses including breast cancer and Alzheimer's disease.
Says he was raised as a Republican but switched his party affiliation to Democratic.

priorities.text: Says he will fight to cut taxes for working and middle-class families rather than the wealthy.
Says he will oppose attempts to weaken Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, or veterans' benefits.

positions.summary: Says he will fight to cut taxes for working and middle-class families while making the wealthiest Americans pay their fair share.
positions.quote: Danny will fight to put money back in the pockets of everyday Texans and make sure the richest Americans finally pay their fair share.

positions.summary: Supports strong, fair immigration enforcement combined with a path to citizenship for people who want to contribute to the country.
positions.quote: Danny supports strong, fair immigration enforcement that keeps us safe and treats people with dignity. He believes in enforcing the law while creating a clear and efficient path to citizenship for those who want to contribute to our country.

positions.summary: Says he will fight any attempt to weaken Social Security, Medicare, or Medicaid.
positions.quote: Danny will fight any attempt to weaken Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, or the VA. These are not entitlements. They are earned promises we must keep.
